title: [BUG] [alpha] multiCursor getSelectionLength double-counts newlines
summary: Multi-line selection length overcounts newline characters because middle-line newlines and cross-line newlines are both added.
steps: Create a 3-line selection where line 2 is a middle line.
Compare with index-diff length from flattened text.
expected: Selection length should equal endIndex - startIndex in flattened text.
actual: Function returns one extra character due to duplicate newline accounting.
